data.exact_reserve_text: As a result, the claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves totaling GBP 71.180 million, representing a 52.79% increase over opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by a material increase in incurred claims for the 2013 and prior years of account, particularly within the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers, and medical malpractice classes of business, which fall under Third Party Liability. The 2014 year of account also contributed to the adverse development.
raw_causal_phrases: large deterioration that arose on the 2013 and prior years of account on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
significant increase in the incurred claims position on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 18 states a 'net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account', totaling GBP 35.8 million net. However, the Technical Provisions note on page 16 shows 'Changes for prior years' as Gross GBP 71,180k and Net GBP 53,469k. The table figure for gross prior year development (GBP 71.180m) is used as it is a direct accounting figure, but there is a notable discrepancy with the narrative's net figure.
